data.revised_prompt: A sprite sheet for a mobile Three Kingdoms pixel arcade game, transparent background. Arrange clearly separated reusable environment props with generous spacing: ancient Chinese military gatehouse, two wooden gate posts, left and right palisade wall sections, war banners, brazier, wooden barricade, crates, weapon rack. Front-facing or slight three-quarter view, crisp hard pixel edges, limited earthy bronze and red palette, each object fully visible with clean bottom grounding edge. No characters, no text, no UI, no scenery background, no shadows outside objects.
